When you write if let DoubleTapSetting::Fixed(ms) = `settings.double_tap_window_ms` where settings: &Settings, Rust's match ergonomics (RFC 2005, stable since Rust `1.26`) automatically insert a ref binding. The compiler sees the scrutinee is behind a reference, so it matches by reference -- ms becomes a u32 copy (since u32: Copy). There is no move of the `DoubleTapSetting` enum itself.

The bot's statement that "Rust's Copy trait is all-or-nothing per type, not per variant" is true in isolation but irrelevant here -- match ergonomics mean the enum is never moved. The compiler doesn't need the enum to be Copy because it's pattern-matching through a reference.
